name: WLAN Monitor
author: uBruckhaus
description: See who is on your Wi-Fi from the bar: every device with a type icon and plain-language status, your own names, new-device alerts, groups by platform, type or Wi-Fi band, a network map, FRITZ!Box mesh details and VPN detection that explains when a VPN blocks your home network. Active scans only on trusted networks.

barWidget.description: Devices on your Wi-Fi, router access, signal and traffic
